why: Both analyses propose nearly the same surgeon-conversion hedgehog and miss the key's bounded-growth march, while both flag the suture-maker entry threat, the single-technology dependence and the channel-loading risk; Analysis 2 is more explicit about scrapping the commission-only, fire-fast policy. Analysis 1 is better calibrated (stated low-to-moderate confidence, a lower potential score, and it says the post-loss recovery claim needs internal data where Analysis 2 asserts it), and its decline risks carry concrete triggers, including a revenue-recognition review.
